title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: Each quantity must be expressed correctly in terms of hbar, e, c, m, and M with numerical estimates provided.

title: Correct Formulas
description: Important Criteria: The correct equations for each quantity must be used in the derivations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Important Criteria: All final answers must include appropriate units and be consistent throughout.

title: Numerical Accuracy
description: Optional Criteria: Numerical estimates should be roughly accurate and reflect common values.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the equations.
